from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper in the collection: its own title and the titles of other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that this paper cites, based on its reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
